logs: Review of state-core: Not a base to build on yet: 15 major and 15 minor findings, no blockers. Every check passes, but the code differs from the plan in several places the next units depend on. (1) init is not restartable at two kill points, it writes the state branch with an update-ref that overwrites, it creates a branch and then crashes when .factory/ is non-empty, it mounts an unmounted legacy branch, and it exits 2 for partial where the plan says exit 1 with fields. (2) Records' flush relies on changed_paths, which mangles dotfiles and quoted names, and on check_paths, which silently passes files it cannot read. (3) Crashes still exit 1 (a deleted cwd; --version with a damaged manifest), and errors during command resolution print no JSON. (4) The body-line size_cap check is missing. (5) ensure_excludes corrupts an exclude file that has no trailing newline. (6) detection.py restates every SPECS default, and init writes the literal protected_paths, so the AU-T2-15 computed default never applies to an init'd project. Of the 13 findings marked fixed, 6 hold (P3SEAM-06, SL1-47, SL1-48, SL1-49, VSA-17, SL1-27): reverting each fix in a scratch copy fails its test. Seven overclaim: AU-S2-03, AU-T2-13, AU-T2-15, AU-P2-03, AU-S2-09, AU-S2-12, AU-P2-17. Of the 8 left-for-builder, 7 are right; the text of P3OPS-11 claims report keys were added, and they were not. Three tests in plan section 7 cannot fail for what they are named after (raw tokens, retry_command, class precedence); I broke each in a scratch copy and the suite stayed green. The fresh-clone mount from origin works when tried by hand but has no test. Foreign items seen: spec_lint reports topics/event-log.md line 41 (another unit's file). After my check.py run, cpython-314 bytecode appeared under next/plugins/vsdd-factory/py/vsdd/__pycache__ and vsdd/hooks/__pycache__ (config, project, hooks/shell, hooks/gitfs, written 16:41-16:42). My experiments ran Python 3.11 with -B and never imported the hooks modules, so this is a concurrent unit's (hook-runner). It would now fail nothing_generated_under_plugin; I left it in place. Findings file: /Users/jmagady/dev2/vsdd-factory/rewrite/findings/sources/extra-step3-state-core-review.json. 30 findings, 15 blocker or major.
Round 1 for state-core: 24 of 30 fixes confirmed, 13 still open.
Round 2 for state-core: 13 of 13 fixes confirmed, 1 still open.

Final battery: check.py 30/30, node 27/27, spec_lint 0 problems on my file, findings build OK, full pytest 679 passed with one foreign failure. Deferred: new/list, --hub/--fresh, command detection trials, toolchain key-fill, artifact_frozen.
findings_left: P3OPS-11 — G2 (S1 added the report keys)
departures_from_plan: changed_paths returns project-relative paths prefixed .factory/ and passes -uall to git status, so untracked files are listed individually; the plan fixed neither the prefix nor the collapsing, and the module convention ('relative to the project root, starting .factory/') made the prefix the consistent choice.
find_project_root now also treats an empty HOME as unset (not only None), a one-line hardening inside the SL1-48 fix so a wiped environment variable cannot stop the walk at the working directory.

test_key_table_parity holds the shipped sample instance to SPECS (every sample key is in SPECS, sample loads clean) rather than demanding the sample repeat every section, because the sample omits [hooks]; filed as new finding S3B-state-core-1 instead of editing the sample, which is another package's file.

init --hub, init --fresh; command detection (trial runs, the JUnit report, the {port} check); the unclassed-tracked-files list
config set, refs, coverage; P/schemas/config.schema.json (decision 5: no schema file ships)

the artifact_frozen check (record stores, records unit)
the prelude's per-schema empty values for relayed commands (ORDER.md ledger item, W2/prelude)

fix.summary: Fixed all 30 review findings for the state-core unit (S1) of vsdd-factory 1.0 on branch rewrite/v1. Source changes: detection.py renders factory.toml from SPECS alone (no hand-typed key copy, no frozen protected_paths, protected derived from the detected release branch); cmd_init.py restart-safe (excludes before mount and on the ready path, update-ref with empty old value, up-front refusal of a non-empty .factory for none and unmounted, unmounted legacy branch reported not mounted, partial exits 1 with next naming /vsdd-factory:status --fix); mount.py prunes dangling worktree registrations, clears an interrupted .factory/.git pointer mount, and writes the exclude file atomically with newline repair; cli.py guards the dispatch call and drops dead plugin_version; dispatch.py resolves the start directory inside the try (deleted-cwd safe, relative -C made absolute), handles --version inside the try, hoists --json parsing before command resolution, adds --help, RegistrationError for malformed registrations, command-word error labels, the condition in the un-initialised refusal, and find_spec-based package skipping; artifacts.py adds the 1,000-character body-line size_cap, unreadable-file Problems, a porcelain -z changed_paths that no longer mangles dotfile/space/non-ASCII names, both waived-path forms, compile-time validation of registry type cells and ref: targets, and the malformed AC-heading flag; gitrun.py strips repository-locating GIT_* variables, maps a missing git to GitError and decodes timeout stderr; globs.py makes '**/' match zero directories; cmd_validate.py counts only checked artifact files, refuses --changed with PATHs and missing PATHs, and uses the new public tree_rels. Ledger corrections in rewrite/findings/outcomes/step3-state-core.json (AU-S2-03, AU-T2-13, AU-P2-03, AU-S2-09, AU-P2-17 re-recorded left-for-builder with what remains; AU-T2-15 and AU-S2-12 finished; P3OPS-11 text corrected) plus the two spec-prose fixes (config/hooks.md rule count, commands/validate.md single syntax, topics/state-directory.md ready row). All work confined to the unit's own files; the records and survey units' future surfaces (check_paths, tree_rels, mounted) kept compatible.

Break tests, each applied alone to a clean scratch copy and reverted afterwards:
- S3R-1: four breaks, all caught. Dropping limits.gate_minutes, writing agents_per_run=999, writing protected_paths, and a hand-typed [project] tuple that leaves out layout.
- S3R-3: two breaks, both caught. update-ref without the empty old value fails test_create_branch_twice_keeps_the_first_commit. Init ignoring a lost race fails test_init_losing_a_concurrent_create_mounts_the_winner.
- S3R-13: two breaks, both caught. A facade that imports every sibling on the first lookup fails test_import_loads_no_submodule. A planted relayed command (output=survey, failure spikes_used='none') fails test_shipped_commands_register_cleanly, while the valid control passes. No shipped command declares an output today, so that loop runs zero times until one does.
- S3R-23: deleting the branches.protected derivation fails only the master-only test.
- S3R-28: reproduced the Linux layout with a folder holding only uv. Without the interpreter's folder on PATH it exits 2 with "uv found no Python 3.11 or newer". With it, init answers ready.
- C1-1: a lenient _is_interrupted_mount fails both nested-repository tests. Removing the points-back check or the common-dir check leaves every test green. Those two are untested safeguards whose loss would cost only a pointer file. Interrupted mounts are still accepted with both absolute and relative worktree paths (worktree.useRelativePaths).
- C1-2: the partition-based check fails the hyphen test. Exact-match only fails test_longest_words_win, so refinement modules are still covered.
- C1-3: without the identity lines and with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, test_init_origin_mount fails (KeyError 'state'). With them it passes.
- C1-4: an is_dir-only refusal fails the plain-file test. Also probed: a dangling symlink and a symlink to a non-empty folder are refused with no branch left, and a symlink to an empty folder mounts ready.
- C1-7: removing the wrap fails test_registry_compiles_cells_loudly.
